parameters.name: all
parameters.description: When true, includes Deactivated paths too.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size of a collection GET (REST guideline 3.2): an integer from 1 to 500, default 100. Anything else is 400 `invalid-limit`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token: the previous page's `nextCursor`, passed back unchanged together with the same filters. Absent on the first page. A value this API did not issue is 400 `invalid-cursor`.
